resources.string: Executes hold-to-tap automated screen taps at your configured keymap coordinates when you press and hold the floating GLOW FIRST Trigger overlay.
Keeps the floating Trigger overlay active while gaming.
Hold the floating Trigger circle to tap at %1$d CPS. Tap Stop to hide overlay.
Display over other apps permission is required to show the floating Trigger.
GLOW FIRST Accessibility Service is disabled. Enable it in Settings to perform taps.
Could not load the selected screenshot. Please choose a valid image.
Enter a valid CPS value between 1 and 30.
Macro configuration is missing. Please select a screenshot and save your keymap first.
Android rejected the tap gesture. Ensure the Accessibility Service is active and no system dialog is blocking input.
